description: This Go source file defines a 'Filter' type for manipulating YAML objects based on specified field paths, including logic for matching object kinds and creating or updating nested fields within YAML nodes, used within the kustomize project.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates logic for filtering and mutating YAML nodes based on a specified FieldSpec, including creation and update behaviors.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Method that applies the filter to a YAML object if the object matches the specified GroupVersionKind, modifying the object as needed.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Recursive helper method that traverses the YAML node structure to locate and modify the target field based on the path.

methods.name: handleMap
methods.description: Handles filtering logic for YAML mapping nodes, including creating missing fields if configured.

methods.name: handleSequence
methods.description: Applies filtering to each element in a YAML sequence node.

methods.name: isSequenceField
methods.description: Determines if a path element refers to a sequence field, returning the base name and a boolean.

methods.name: isMatchGVK
methods.description: Checks if a YAML node's Group, Version, and Kind match the specified FieldSpec.
